subject: Governance checkpoint: vendor intake & PO timeline for Lumen Health
body:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Cho <sabrina.cho@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 16:21:00 -0700
Subject: Governance checkpoint: vendor intake & PO timeline for Lumen Health

Hi Sabrina —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and the governance items we promised to surface:

- Decision criteria: performance under 200ms tail latency for chat workflows, audit logs retention for 12 months, and ability to run in our VPC.
- Economic buyer: you mentioned Alan Pierce (VP of AI Ops) — can you confirm he will sign the PO/contract?
- Procurement intake: who owns the vendor intake form on your side (name/email)?
- Security/legal: will Joshua Patel from InfoSec be the primary reviewer for the security questionnaire? Any specific evidence (SOC 2, encryption keys, data flow diagrams) they require upfront?
- Billing & PO: what is the PO owner and the billing contact/email? Do you require a vendor W9 and our Ariba/portal entry?
- Target timeline: you indicated a Q4 pilot; can you confirm target go-live month so we can align ops?

Next steps I propose:
1) You share the vendor intake + PO template — we’ll return a completed intake + W9 and a security summary by EOD next business day.
2) We’ll assign a single billing contact (cc below) and a point person to work with procurement.
3) Once procurement confirms the intake gate, we can aim for a PO within 2–3 weeks of approval.

If that aligns, I’ll collate the ask list and route internally.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

--

Hi Mateo —

Appreciate the recap and the clarity. Quick answers inline:

- Alan Pierce will be the economic approver for this engagement — he signs the PO/contract after Legal and Procurement clear the vendor terms.
- Procurement intake is handled by our Vendor Operations team; I’m attaching the intake form and our PO template for Redwood to complete.
- Joshua will own the security review; he typically asks for SOC 2 Type II and a short security summary describing data flows and key management. He may request additional technical interviews for the VPC setup.
- Billing contact for Lumen: procurement@lumenhealth.com — please put invoice remit to accounts-payable@lumenhealth.com in the PO.
- Timeline: vendor intake + docs → procurement review (2 weeks) → legal review & contract (1 week) → PO issuance (target 3rd week after intake).

Attachments: Lumen_Vendor_Intake.pdf (vendor intake form), Lumen_PO_Template.xlsx (PO template)

Can you return the intake and W9? Also if you can provide a 1–2 page security summary up front that would help Joshua triage.

Thanks,
Sabrina Cho
Sr. Sourcing Manager, Lumen Health

Mateo / Jasmine —

Thanks for the ping and the attachments. Quick status from Finance & Security: 

- Finance: we can accept PO to billing@redwood-inference.com. Standard remit address is invoices@redwood-inference.com; we typically accept NET45 for large enterprise but can do NET30 for pilots if requested. We will provide a redwood W9 and vendor profile export by EOD tomorrow.
- Security: the attached "Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf" covers SOC 2 status, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integrations, and a simple data flow diagram. Joshua will still want to schedule a short tech call for the VPC setup — I'll loop him.
- Suggested internal timeline to meet Lumen's window: complete intake + docs by Nov 5, route to Procurement week of Nov 8, legal review and DocuSign by Nov 16, PO issuance target Nov 18–19, pilot readiness by Nov 30.

Action items I will do:
- Attach W9 & finalize vendor profile (send to Mateo).
- Confirm billing contact in our vendor portal and provide the vendor ID for Lumen to reference in the PO.
- Coordinate a 30-min technical call between Joshua and our infra lead (cc Jasmine).

Jasmine, can you prepare the short infra checklist for the tech call (VPC peering endpoints, allowed CIDRs, expected concurrent sessions)?

Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-3087

Hi everyone —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. This alignment looks good — procurement has accepted the intake form in preliminary review. Two notes: 

1) Legal wants the vendor profile + W9 attached to the DocuSign envelope. I see Neha is preparing those — please route to legal@lumenhealth.com.
2) Joshua, when you and Neha schedule the tech call, please include a slide or sample config showing KMS/keyflow and the VPC peering steps; that will speed Legal's sign-off for the data flow bit.

Tentative dates based on current capacity:
- Legal review & DocuSign sent by Nov 16
- PO issuance by Nov 18 (procurement will prioritize once legal releases the envelope)
- Pilot kickoff week of Nov 30 (target)

I’ll update the HubSpot record (HS-74829) with intake accepted and notify Alan Pierce that Procurement + Legal are aligned on timeline.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123456

Thanks — Sabrina
Sr. Sourcing Manager, Lumen Health
